rule: Assumption register (FRAMEWORK.md area 13(b)) for Resilience IQ: the 24 assumptions of VALIDATION.md 4.4 (legacyId A1-A24) and the LTM heuristics flagged in DESIGN.md section 17, each with value, basis (client input / published source with claim ID / LTM heuristic with reasoning), confidence, sensitivity (what changes if it is wrong) and claim IDs. status says whether v2 keeps, changes or retires it. RQ3 adds the constants the v2 engine reads and a test that each matches the code, as FinOps IQ does.

basisValues.client_input: Given by the client (exact, band or evidence)
basisValues.published_source: Published source with a claim ID in the claims register
basisValues.ltm_heuristic: LTM heuristic with reasoning; not a market fact

statusValues.retired_in_v2: Removed by RQ3; listed so the golden diff is explained
statusValues.under_review_rq6: Decided when the modes are timed (RQ6)

ownerApproval: Design defaults approved by the owner on 28 Oct 2026 (D1-D15, Q1-Q15); values pending RQ5 calibration

assumptions.title: Domain weights
assumptions.value: BCP 0.18, DR 0.20, Cyber 0.18, Operations 0.16, Third parties 0.12, Infrastructure 0.16
assumptions.reasoning: Recovery and cyber recovery weigh most for a critical service; no published weighting exists.
assumptions.sensitivity: About 3-4 posture points per 0.05 moved between two domains

assumptions.title: Option scores per question
assumptions.value: scoring-model.json question_scoring (0-100 per option)
assumptions.reasoning: Ranks answers by the capability they show; Unknown scores as risk.
assumptions.sensitivity: EX-12 alone moves posture about 12 points; RQ5 sets a per-answer limit

assumptions.title: Evidence confidence multiplier
assumptions.value: 0.7 + 0.3 x (none 0.5 / self-declared 0.7 / documented 0.85 / tested 0.95 / independently validated 1.0)
assumptions.reasoning: Ordinal steps from claimed to independently validated evidence.

assumptions.title: Unanswered and Unknown answers never flatter
assumptions.value: v1: unanswered domain scores 0. v2: a blank question that was asked counts as Unknown (R9 decision 1)
assumptions.reasoning: Product decision R8 and R9 decision 1: missing data must not raise the result.
assumptions.sensitivity: Prevents the +6 posture flattering found at 30% blank answers (validation 4.5)

assumptions.title: Advisory domain adjustments
assumptions.value: advisory_adjustments per flag, domain cap 20; v1 overall penalty (cap 20) retired with the risk-adjusted score
assumptions.reasoning: Advisory findings refine the domains they evidence; one effect per answer (Q11).

assumptions.title: Rating bands
assumptions.value: Exposed 0-39 (renamed from Critical Exposure, Q15), Fragile 40-59, Managed 60-74, Resilient 75-89, Adaptive 90-100
assumptions.reasoning: Common five-band scale; rename avoids confusion with critical exposure.

assumptions.title: Exposure caps
assumptions.value: Severe exposure caps the rating at Fragile; High exposure at Managed; cap reason always shown
assumptions.reasoning: R3 D1, confirmed by R9 decision 5 (D2).
assumptions.sensitivity: Rating label (for example 86 shown as Managed)

assumptions.title: Maturity thresholds
assumptions.value: Reactive < 40, Documented 40-59, Defined 60-74, Tested 75-89, Adaptive >= 90
assumptions.reasoning: Aligned with the rating bands so the labels never contradict.

assumptions.title: "Tested" needs a test within 12 months and scenario exercises
assumptions.value: 12 months
assumptions.reasoning: DORA Art. 11(6), CPS 230 para 43 and 23 NYCRR 500.16(d) all require at least annual testing.
assumptions.sensitivity: Maturity at most Defined without a test in 12 months

assumptions.title: Critical exposure levels
assumptions.value: Severe: 3 or more Critical; High: 1 or more Critical or 4 or more High
assumptions.reasoning: A single Critical gap can stop a critical service; several High gaps compound.

assumptions.title: Pattern base score and bonuses
assumptions.reasoning: Replaced by the written ladder (D3); conflicted with AWS bands (C2).
assumptions.sensitivity: Changed the recommended strategy; removed in RQ3

assumptions.title: Cyber, concentration, dependency and advisory pattern bonuses
assumptions.value: v1 runtime.ts:593-628
assumptions.reasoning: v2 modifiers add controls, never a rung (D3).

assumptions.title: Environment priority
assumptions.value: v1: AWS > Azure > Google Cloud > on-premises (+3 tie-break)
assumptions.reasoning: v2 is vendor-neutral: playbook entries for every platform the client selects, with no priority.

assumptions.title: Confidence label from evidence
assumptions.value: v1: High >= 80, Moderate >= 60, else Low, with deductions; v2: from validated evidence per finding
assumptions.reasoning: Evidence changes confidence (R10.4).

assumptions.title: Roadmap windows
assumptions.value: v1: 0-30 days, 31-90 days, 3-6 months, 6-18 months; v2: time frames by severity
assumptions.reasoning: Sequencing judgement over 18 months.

assumptions.title: Wave allocation, at most 4 actions per wave
assumptions.value: v1 code
assumptions.reasoning: v2 puts every finding on the roadmap; nothing is dropped silently.

assumptions.title: Flat penalties
assumptions.value: v1: 10 / 15 / 8 / 8 / 6 / 8 on the hidden risk-adjusted score
assumptions.reasoning: D4 and Q11: one headline, one effect per answer; severity is carried by gaps and the cap.

assumptions.title: Gap severities
assumptions.value: Critical, High, Medium, Low per DESIGN.md 9.4
assumptions.reasoning: Critical = can stop a critical service within tolerance or invalidate recovery.

assumptions.title: Unknown treated as the worse case
assumptions.value: v1: Unknown as "Potentially" (cyber) and moderate (concentration); v2: Unknown raises the Critical case (G-04, G-05, G-06)
assumptions.reasoning: Unknown counts as risk (R9 decision 1).

assumptions.title: Moderate concentration raises Critical G-04
assumptions.value: v1 decision tree
assumptions.reasoning: R9 decision 6: moderate concentration gives G-08 (High) only.

assumptions.title: v1 rule: retention-locked backups with restore not proven = Critical G-03
assumptions.value: v1 decision tree
assumptions.reasoning: R9 decision 3: becomes High "Unproven recovery".

assumptions.title: Answer bands in hours
assumptions.reasoning: v2 uses the band bounds, so a gap is a range, never a point guess.

assumptions.title: At most 8 advisory questions per round
assumptions.value: v1 runtime.ts:813
assumptions.reasoning: Keeps a round short; RQ6 times the modes.
assumptions.sensitivity: Depth and session length; no score effect

assumptions.title: Pattern cost and complexity order
assumptions.value: Backup and restore < pilot light < warm standby < hot standby < active-active
assumptions.reasoning: AWS lists the strategies in increasing order of cost and complexity.

assumptions.title: RTO band edges
assumptions.value: < 15 min hot standby; 15-60 min warm standby; 1-4 h pilot light; 4-24 h and > 24 h backup and restore
assumptions.reasoning: Provider bands overlap the answer edges; the lowest pattern that meets the whole band is chosen.
assumptions.sensitivity: One rung per service; calibrated on RS1-RS5 in RQ5

assumptions.title: RPO band edges
assumptions.value: Near-zero and < 15 min warm standby; 15-60 min pilot light; >= 1 h backup and restore
assumptions.reasoning: As ASM-RES-025; point-in-time recovery reaches 5 minutes only "in some cases".

assumptions.title: Ladder rule
assumptions.value: Recommended rung = max(rung for RTO, rung for RPO)
assumptions.reasoning: Lowest-cost pattern that meets both objectives.

assumptions.title: Active-active only as a business choice
assumptions.value: Offered beside hot standby only when RTO < 15 min and RPO near-zero
assumptions.reasoning: D3; Q9 kept for RQ5.

assumptions.title: Consistency rule
assumptions.value: RTO or RPO looser than the tolerance: the stricter value is used and a High conflict raised
assumptions.reasoning: Owner default Q1.
assumptions.sensitivity: Can raise the rung for that service

assumptions.title: Severity rules
assumptions.value: DESIGN.md 9.4 table
assumptions.reasoning: Built on the blueprint Critical definition.

assumptions.title: Severity time frames
assumptions.value: Critical 0-3 months, High 3-6, Medium 6-12, Low 12-24
assumptions.reasoning: Sequencing judgement.

assumptions.title: Obligation uplift
assumptions.value: Applies-now obligation not evidenced: finding at least High; never for FFIEC
assumptions.reasoning: Regulatory duty not evidenced is a supervisory risk.
assumptions.sensitivity: Medium to High for cited findings

assumptions.title: Three-year audit line
assumptions.value: DORA Art. 11(3) and CPS 230 para 46: audit more than 3 years ago = partly
assumptions.reasoning: Borrowed from MAS BCM 8.2, the only stated interval.

assumptions.title: Five-service limit
assumptions.value: At most 5 services per workshop
assumptions.reasoning: Keeps a workshop within a day.

assumptions.title: Provider term mapping
assumptions.value: Google cold/warm/hot and Azure terms mapped to the five patterns
assumptions.reasoning: Google gives no bands; Azure "hot standby" is active-active.

assumptions.title: Cost per hour of disruption
assumptions.value: Client input, low-high range per service; no default
assumptions.reasoning: D5: no invented money; published data is context only.

assumptions.title: MAS four-hour RTO floor
assumptions.value: Effective RTO at most 1-4 hours where the consultant confirms a MAS critical system
assumptions.reasoning: TRM Notices para 6 for all eleven current licence types (Q6 settled).
assumptions.sensitivity: Can raise the rung for that service

assumptions.title: Obligation status rule
assumptions.value: All checks meet = met; some = partly; none = not evidenced; Unknown fails
assumptions.reasoning: D6: indicative, never a compliance opinion.
